# 40.00 USD sold against INV-USD-001's cost basis before the invoice is collected.
#
# The cost basis is the invoice's posting split, which the test fills in for
# BASIS. A receivable that has not been collected holds no currency to sell,
# and `cost_basis_force: true` says the money is in hand anyway, so the sale
# draws 40.00 USD out of the posting split's balance and leaves 60.00.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_converting_settlement_needs_the_cost_basis_it_draws_on.py.
2026-02-01 * "Sell 40 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -40.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "-56.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "BASIS"
		cost_basis_force: true
	Assets:Bank 54.80 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "54.80"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
